preconditions.description: The graph has n vertices (1 ≤ n ≤ 100) and m edges (0 ≤ m ≤ n(n-1)/2), with no multiple edges or self-loops.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'FHTAGN!' if (has_cycle(graph) and all(is_tree(remove_cycle_edge(graph)) for _ in cycle_edges(graph))) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'FHTAGN!' if and only if the graph is a Cthulhu graph: it contains exactly one simple cycle, and the remaining graph (after removing any one edge from the cycle) decomposes into three or more rooted trees whose roots are the cycle vertices.
